# Historical vectors (not executed)

Pre-alignment test vectors for the earlier depth-4 registry and circomlib
Poseidon construction, kept byte-identical because the provenance records of
the alignment cite them (12 files, all unchanged).

- `circom/`: 6 integrated-circuit inputs (formerly `circom/inputs/eprescription/historical/`)
- `noir/pre_alignment_depth4/`: 1 positive and 5 negative vectors (formerly
  `noir/phase4_orchestrator/tests/historical/pre_alignment_depth4/`)

They do not match the current protocol and no test uses them. The current
vectors are generated by `circom/scripts/build_canonical_fixture.js`.

## Protocol v1 (`v1/`)

The vectors, fixture and cross-backend KAT results of protocol v1, the
version measured in the benchmark release `bench-evidence-2026-10-30`
(commit `f257cad`, merged as `b92dd82`). In v1 the commitment was
`C = H1(pid, did, med, expiry, threshold)` and the patient reference was only
used on the issuance side (`PB = H6(I, C)`), so the redemption circuit did not
bind `patient_secret` to `C`: a holder of a valid issuance record could redeem
it under any other secret and obtain fresh nullifiers. Protocol v2 includes
`I = H2(patient_secret)` in `C`; see `docs/protocol_specification.md`,
Section 6, and the new attack vectors NT-021 and NT-022.

- `v1/kat/`: `canonical_fixture.json`, `cross_backend_kat_results.json` (107/107 equal)
- `v1/circom/`: TV-001..005, NT-001..020, `patient_binding_issuance.json`
- `v1/noir/`: positive and negative `.toml` vectors

Kept byte-identical to commit `b92dd82`; no test uses them.
